chapter.verse: Tua mun panin Negeb gamah Abraham paisuk a, Kadesh leh Shur kikal Gerar-ah tawl khat sung teng hi.
Abraham in a zi Sarah pen, “Ka sanggamnu hi,” ci hi. Gerar kumpipa Abimelek in mi sawl-in Sarah samsak hi.
Ahih hangin zan-in mang sungah Abimelek kiangah Pasian pai a, ama' kiangah, “En in, na laksa numei’ hangin nang in a si ding na hi hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in mi khat’ zi ahi hi,” ci hi.
Tu-in Abimelek in amah zuan nai lo hi; tua ahih ciangin amah in, “Topa aw, nang in mi dikpa that ding na hi hiam?

Amahmah in kei kiangah, ‘Amah in ka sanggamnu ahi hi,’ hong ci hilo ahi hiam? A numei mahmah in zong, ‘Amah in ka sanggampa ahi hi,’ hong ci hi. Tua ahih ciangin lungsim kisuang het loin a gamta ka hi a, khial ka kisa kei hi,” ci hi.

Tua ciangin Pasian in mang sungah ama' kiangah, “Hi hi, lungsim kisuan’na om loin hih bangin na gamtatna thu ka thei a, kei' tungah na khialh loh nadinga hong kempa in keimah ka hi hi; tua ahih ciangin nangmah kong lawngsak kei hi.

Tua ahih ciangin tu-in mipa’ zi pia kik in; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in kamsangpa khat hi a, amah in nang’ adingin thu hong ngetsak ding a, nang na nungta ding hi. Ahih hangin nang in tua numei na piak kik kei leh nang leh na neih khempeuh na sih taktak ding uh thei in,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin zingsangin Abimelek tho baih a, a nasemte samin hih thute khempeuh amaute' kiangah gen hi; amaute nak lau mahmah uh hi.

Tua ciangin Abimelek in Abraham samin ama' kiangah, “Kote tungah bang hong bawl na hi hiam? Kei leh ka kumpigamsungah khialhna lianpi khat nong tut nadingin nang' tungah bang hong ci khialh ka hi hiam? Hih dinga kilawm lo nate kei’ tungah nong hih hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Abimelek in Abraham kiangah, “Hih banga na gamtat nadingin bang ngaihsun na hi hiam?” ci hi.
Abraham in, “Hih lai munah Pasian zahtakna om het lo hi, ka zi’ hangin amaute in kei hong that ding hi, ci-in ngaihsun kha ka hih manin hih bangin ka gamta hi.
Tua tham loin a taktakin amah in ka sanggamnu mah ahi hi, pa kikhat, nu tuam ka hi uh hi; amah ka tenpih hi.
Pasian in ka pa’ inn panin hong paikhiatsak ciangin ama' kiangah, ‘Hih in kei tunga nong hih ding na migitna ahi hi: I paina peuhpeuh-ah kei pen, ka sanggampa hi,’ hong ci-in, ka ci hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin Abimelek in tuu leh bawngtalte, pasal-sila leh numei-silate la-in Abraham pia a, ama' tungah a zi Sarah piakik hi.
Abimelek in, “En in, ka leitang in na mai-ah om hi; nangmah in hoih nasakna munah teng in,” ci hi.

Sarah’ kiangah, “En in, na sanggampa’ tungah ngun shekel tul khat ka pia khin hi; nang tawh a om mite khempeuh’ mai-ah nangma' dikna a kilatna ahi hi; mi khempeuh’ mai-ah nang a manin hong kibawl hi,” amah in ci hi.
Tua ciangin Abraham in Pasian' tungah thungen a, Pasian in Abimelek damsak hi. Amaute in ta a neih theih nadingin a zi leh a numei-silate zong damsak hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in Abraham’ zi Sarah’ hangin Abimelek’ innkuan’ naubu khempeuh khakcipsak khin hi.
